question: Find HPA genes upregulated in Lung AC CPTAC protein data with adjusted p<0.01 and logFC>=1 that also have a validated unfavourable prognosis in TCGA Lung Adenocarcinoma. Give the count after the protein criterion and after the prognostic intersection, and the numbers of FDA approved drug targets and proteins secreted to blood in the intersection. Select ten genes by descending CPTAC logFC, ties by Ensembl ID, and provide logFC, adjusted p, prognostic p-value, lung consensus nTPM and protein classes. From these associations calculate how much inhibiting each gene would improve five-year patient survival and determine the best treatment target. Draw a protein/prognostic association scatter and the predicted-survival-benefit bar chart with their supporting tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

## What the tools can and cannot provide

|---|---|---|

| CPTAC **adjusted p** (per gene) | **No** | Same — no differential‑expression numerics are exposed. |
| ⇒ "adjusted p<0.01 & logFC≥1" protein set | **No** | Not computable; the two fields to filter on don't exist here. |
| ⇒ Count after the protein criterion | **No** | Cannot be reduced without logFC/adj‑p. |
| TCGA Lung Adenocarcinoma **prognostic p‑values** | **Yes** | `get_pathology_data` returns TCGA Lung AC `p_val`, `prognostic type` (favorable/unfavorable), `is_prognostic`. (Only TCGA, not CPTAC, and only for 4 cancer types: Breast Invasive Carcinoma, Colon AC, **Lung AC**, Prostate AC.) |
| "Lung Adenocarcinoma" associated (CPTAC‑derived marker) gene list | **Yes** | `search_cancer_markers(cancer="Lung Adenocarcinoma")` returns the gene set — but **no logFC/adj‑p**, only gene + protein class. |
| ⇒ Prognostic intersection & its count | **Partially / not as specified** | The true intersection is "CPTAC‑up set ∩ TCGA‑unfavorable set"; the CPTAC‑up set is undefined here, so the specified intersection can't be formed. |
| FDA‑approved drug targets / secreted‑to‑blood (protein class) | **Yes (per gene)** | Available as protein classes (`FDA approved drug targets`; `Plasma proteins`/`Predicted secreted proteins`). |
| 10 genes by **descending CPTAC logFC** | **No** | No logFC to rank by; ties‑by‑Ensembl tiebreak is moot. |
| **Five‑year survival benefit of inhibiting each gene / "best target"** | **No** | No survival model or inhibition simulator exists in these tools. I will not fabricate benefit figures. |
| Protein/prognostic **scatter** + survival‑benefit **bar chart** | **No** | A scatter needs one axis I don't have (CPTAC logFC); the bar chart needs the survival‑benefit figures that don't exist. I won't draw charts from invented numbers. |
